messages:
DeployBot: AUTO-FALLBACK triggered for rollout v3.5.1 -> reverting embeddings route in us-west due to mem spike / OOMs. Action: rollback to v3.4.9 for embeddings. EU region held (no auto-action).
Maya Singh: seeing the same alerts. p95 and worker restarts on model-hosts-41..44. Good call to hold EU.
SRE Oncall: looking at kernel logs. Noise correlates with the new quantize-kv flag flip. kvcache thrash + GC.
Samir Patel: if we do a targeted rollback for embeddings only, that will create cross-region model-version divergence for a bit. Any customer impact?
CS Lead Ava: I've reached out to the two EU dedicated customers on the slack thread, they prefer immediate consistency (rollback) over degraded outputs.
Ops Jordan: I can run manual revert on eu-dedicated pools now. Will need a +1 from release manager to touch the change window?
Release Manager Diego: change window is open for emergency ops. +1 for targeted manual rollback in EU only. Keep hosted/global as-is (deploybot automated rollback in us-west).
Maya Singh: plan: 1) let deploybot finish automated fallback in us-west 2) Ops manually revert eu-dedicated embeddings to v3.4.9 3) Release notes + customer comms 4) Hold any other feature flag flips.
Eli Chen: adding a short note for release notes and rollback tag: pin=rollback-6512345678. Also reverting flag --quantize-kv for affected hosts.
Ops Jordan: executing manual revert for eu-dedicated (running command now):
```
# target eu dedicated pool
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embeddings-service embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v3.4.9 --context=eu-dedicated
# annotate and pin
kubectl annotate deploy/embeddings-service rollback-tag=rollback-6512345678 --context=eu-dedicated
```
Ops Jordan: started rollout, doing one node at a time. ETA ~7m. I'll post progress.
SRE Oncall: tailing logs and metrics. KV cache hitrate drops expected during transition, watching p95 and OOMs.
DeployBot: MANUAL ACTION logged: revert by Ops Jordan for eu-dedicated at 6512345720. Automated rollback completed in us-west at 6512345685.
Ops Jordan: eu-dedicated rollout finished at 6512345798. All pods now at v3.4.9.
Maya Singh: confirming traffic restored and no OOMs on eu hosts. p95 back to baseline in our dashboards.
CS Lead Ava: sent update to customers: short note + what changed and expected behavior. They acknowledged.
Eli Chen: created PR to remove the quantize-kv change from the next batch and flagged for canary re-test after root-cause fix.
Release Manager Diego: updating release notes: added entry under v3.5.1 -> "Targeted rollback for embeddings in eu-dedicated due to kvcache regression; automated fallback executed in us-west."
Samir Patel: postmortem owner assignment? Maya or Eli?
Maya Singh: I'll own immediate postmortem. Will include timeline, metric graphs, and remediation (revert flag + improved canary).
SRE Oncall: continuing to monitor for 2 hours, will escalate if any regressions.
DeployBot: NOTE: system will suppress auto-rollouts for the next 60m for affected model/flags to avoid flip-flopping.
Maya Singh: thanks team. If anything regresses, ping #eng-oncall and we'll re-open. :white_check_mark:
